newsitem.title: USA: Florida doesn't want Klan to adopt a highway.
newsitem.headline: Florida doesn't want Klan to adopt a highway.

text.p: A Ku Klux Klan group is threatening to sue the state of Florida because it refuses to let the racist organisation adopt a highway.
Florida's Department of Transportation turned down the Klan's offer to clean up trash along State Road 415 in rural Florida, citing safety concerns.

"Really, we're just like the Lions or the Elks," Jeff Coleman, Grand Wizard of the Royal Knights of the Ku Klux Klan, said Monday. "We want to be involved in the community. We want our good works to be visible."
Coleman declined to say how many members were in his organisation.
The Klan enlisted the aid of the American Civil Liberties Union in its effort to get its name on a roadside sign.
Until then, Coleman said, he has been out picking up trash in his ceremonial white robe, just so people will know who he is. If he gets the sign, he will leave the robe at home.
"We don't want to pick up a beer can or something and spill it on our robes," he said.
